page.notes: The woodcut initial Q at the start of QUÆSTIO I is transcribed joined to the first word. "saeculorum" is uncertain in the scan and is marked [?]. Line-end hyphens ("Ec-clesia", "per-tineant", "Pontifi-cios") are kept as printed. The page numbers in the right column are read as printed; "45" is a little blurred.
